
```{r}
model_df <- final_df%>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()


## Focus on URBAN DATA:
df_urban <- model_df%>%filter(urban_rural%in%"Urban")

## Log transformations to demographic variables
cols <- c("pct_0_12","pct_13_21","pct_22_40","pct_41_70", "pct_71plus", "pct_0car","pct_1car","pct_2plus","pct_none_primary","pct_secondary","pct_tertiary","pct_still_in_edu")

matrix_urban <- df_urban%>%select(all_of(cols))%>%as.matrix()

variables_ilr <- ilr(acomp(matrix_urban))

variables_ilr_df <- as.data.frame(variables_ilr)

names(variables_ilr_df) <- paste0("ilr","_", cols[-length(cols)])

df_urban_model <- df_urban%>%select(-all_of(cols))%>%bind_cols(variables_ilr_df)



# 1. Prepare data:

df_urban_model <- df_urban_model%>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(category),
    county = factor(COUNTY_ENGLISH),
    urban_area = factor(SA_URBAN_AREA_NAME),
    log_places_density = log1p(places_density_km2),
    log_area = log1p(area_km2),
    z_log_places_density = as.numeric(scale(log_places_density)),
    z_log_area = as.numeric(scale(log_area)),
    z_target_pop_norm = as.numeric(scale(target_pop_norm)),
    krig_se = sqrt(krig_var)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(krig_value),
    !is.na(category),
    !is.na(z_log_places_density),
    !is.na(z_log_area),
    !is.na(z_target_pop_norm),
    !is.na(county),
    !is.na(urban_area)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
ilr_vars <- names(df_urban_model) %>% 
  keep(~ str_starts(.x, "ilr_"))

df_urban_model <- df_urban_model %>%
  mutate(
    perc_active_prop = perc_active / 100,
    perc_active_beta = (perc_active_prop * (nrow(.) - 1) + 0.5) / nrow(.),
    krig_value_z = as.numeric(scale(krig_value))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(ilr_vars),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
      .names = "z_{.col}"
    )
  )

predictors <- c(
  paste0("z_", ilr_vars),
  "krig_value_z",
  "z_log_places_density"
)

formula_beta <- as.formula(
  paste("perc_active_beta ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
)

priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "phi")
)

# shape model
model_urban_krig <- brm(
  formula = formula_beta,
  data = df_urban_model,
  family = Beta(link = "logit"), # the brm will be modelling the mean 
  prior = priors,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1000,
  seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)
```

```{r}
summary(model_urban_krig)
plot(model_urban_krig)
```

```{r}

model_predictors <- all.vars(formula_beta)[-1]

krig_mean <- mean(df_urban_model$krig_value, na.rm = TRUE)
krig_sd <- sd(df_urban_model$krig_value, na.rm = TRUE)

krig_grid <- seq(
  min(df_urban_model$krig_value_z, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(df_urban_model$krig_value_z, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)


newdata_krig <- as_tibble(
  matrix(0, nrow = length(krig_grid), ncol = length(model_predictors))
)

names(newdata_krig) <- model_predictors

newdata_krig <- newdata_krig %>%
  mutate(
    krig_value_z = krig_grid,
    krig_value_original = krig_value_z * krig_sd + krig_mean
  )

pred_krig <- fitted(
  model_urban_krig,
  newdata = newdata_krig,
  scale = "response",
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975)
)

plot_krig <- bind_cols(
  newdata_krig,
  as_tibble(pred_krig)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate_pct = Estimate * 100,
    Q2.5_pct = Q2.5 * 100,
    Q97.5_pct = Q97.5 * 100
  )

ggplot(plot_krig, aes(x = krig_value_original, y = Estimate_pct)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q2.5_pct, ymax = Q97.5_pct), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Marginal prediction for krig_value",
    subtitle = "Other predictors fixed at their average standardized value",
    x = "krig_value",
    y = "Predicted active percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

```

```{r}
# Coefficient table
coef_df <- as.data.frame(fixef(model_urban_krig, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))) %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  filter(term != "Intercept")

# Select strongest ILR variables
top_ilrs <- coef_df %>%
  filter(str_starts(term, "z_ilr_")) %>%
  mutate(abs_estimate = abs(Estimate)) %>%
  slice_max(abs_estimate, n = 6) %>%
  pull(term)

make_ilr_plot_data <- function(var_name) {
  
  var_grid <- seq(
    quantile(df_urban_model[[var_name]], 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    quantile(df_urban_model[[var_name]], 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 80
  )
  
  newdata <- as_tibble(
    matrix(0, nrow = length(var_grid), ncol = length(model_predictors))
  )
  
  names(newdata) <- model_predictors
  
  newdata[[var_name]] <- var_grid
  
  pred <- fitted(
    model_urban_krig,
    newdata = newdata,
    scale = "response",
    probs = c(0.025, 0.975)
  )
  
  bind_cols(
    newdata,
    as_tibble(pred)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      variable = var_name,
      variable_clean = str_replace(var_name, "^z_ilr_", "ilr_"),
      x_value = .data[[var_name]],
      Estimate_pct = Estimate * 100,
      Q2.5_pct = Q2.5 * 100,
      Q97.5_pct = Q97.5 * 100
    )
}

plot_ilr_data <- map_dfr(top_ilrs, make_ilr_plot_data)

ggplot(plot_ilr_data, aes(x = x_value, y = Estimate_pct)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q2.5_pct, ymax = Q97.5_pct), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable_clean, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Marginal predictions for strongest ILR variables",
    subtitle = "Other predictors fixed at their average standardized value",
    x = "Standardized ILR value",
    y = "Predicted active percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
